death.note: doxologia.ro: «A păstorit credicioșii de la Gurile Dunării spre sfârșitul secolului al III-lea… Se crede că Sfântul Mucenic Evanghel a fost martirizat în timpul persecuției lui Dioclețian (284-305).» The page gives the reign and no year, and marks the martyrdom itself as believed rather than recorded.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Evanghel, Episcopul Tomisului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Ευάγγελος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and its whole account is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Ευάγγελος μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους». The identification rests on the day and the name alone, because saint.gr gives him no see and does not repeat the folder's Tomis; the corpus keeps no other Evangelus of any spelling, and a second folder for one man is the worse of the two errors, so the row is taken as his and this is said plainly. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
